section: Andhra Pradesh - government decisions, new schemes, appointments and administrative changes
subsections: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date
Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay

accepted.s: The primary objective of the P4 programme of Andhra Pradesh is to achieve which of the following?
o: Modernisation of the Public Distribution System
accepted.x: P4, or Public-Private-People Partnership, aims at the complete eradication of poverty by linking well-off mentors with poor families.
accepted.tq: Identify the stated primary objective rather than the implementing mechanism.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the P4 programme:
1. It is associated with the Planning Department and poverty eradication.
2. Well-off 'Margadarsis' adopt poor 'Bangaru Kutumbams'.
3. Approximately 9,000 Kuppam families were adopted by Adani, TVS Motor and MEIL.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe the institutional orientation, mentorship model and Kuppam coverage of P4.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the programme’s department, terminology and numerical coverage.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NTR Vaidya Seva is administered through which organisation and is primarily intended for which beneficiaries?
o: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust; BPL families
accepted.x: NTR Vaidya Seva is a health programme administered through the Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust and provides cashless care to BPL families.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair of scheme and department, then eliminate mismatched beneficiary groups.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the latest features of NTR Vaidya Seva mentioned for 2024–26?
o: It is a digital health-profile programme launched statewide in January 2027.
It provides free bus travel and issued 12.76 lakh disability cards.
It provides 3,257 procedures, 1.43 crore health cards and five additional cardiac procedures were added in March 2026.
It provides only 500 procedures and is restricted to persons with more than 40% disability.
accepted.x: NTR Vaidya Seva covered 3,257 procedures and 1.43 crore health cards under APSES 2024–25; five more cardiac procedures were added in March 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate similar health schemes by their service, card and procedure figures.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to Talliki Vandanam, consider the following statements:
1. It is associated with the School Education Department.
2. It provides ₹15,000 per year to mothers subject to 75% attendance.
3. An amount of ₹10,090 crore was provided for 67.27 lakh students.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam belongs to School Education and provides ₹15,000 annually to mothers subject to 75% attendance; the stated allocation covered 67.27 lakh students.
accepted.tq: Verify the department, eligibility condition and paired allocation figures independently.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under PM-Kisan-Annadata Sukhibhava, the annual amount per farmer, including the PM-KISAN component, is:
accepted.x: PM-Kisan-Annadata Sukhibhava provides ₹20,000 per farmer annually, of which ₹6,000 is the PM-KISAN component.
accepted.tq: Split the composite amount from its embedded central component.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Stree Shakti — Free bus travel for women through APSRTC
Divyang Shakti — Free bus travel for all students
Mee Mart — Digital health profiles and ABHA IDs
accepted.x: Stree Shakti is an APSRTC initiative providing free bus travel for women from 15 August 2025.
accepted.tq: Match the benefit with the correct implementing department or service sector.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Free bus travel for women under the Stree Shakti scheme commenced in Andhra Pradesh on:
accepted.x: The Stree Shakti free-travel facility for women began on 15 August 2025.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a scheme’s operational date from its announcement or later coverage figure.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Approximately how many journeys were recorded in the first year of the Stree Shakti scheme?
accepted.x: Stree Shakti recorded approximately 87 crore journeys during its first year.
accepted.tq: Use the scale of the figure to distinguish journeys from beneficiaries or health cards.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Divyang Shakti provides free bus travel to which group?
o: Persons with disabilities having more than 40% disability
accepted.x: Divyang Shakti provides free bus travel to persons with disabilities whose disability exceeds 40%; about 12.76 lakh persons are covered.
accepted.tq: Apply the eligibility threshold to the beneficiary scenario.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mee Mart, established first at Lalupuram in Guntur, is associated with:
o: Digital health profiles through the Health Department
Natural farming through Rythu Sadhikara Samstha
PDS modernisation through Civil Supplies and NCCF
School attendance monitoring through School Education
accepted.x: Mee Mart is a Civil Supplies–NCCF initiative for PDS modernisation; its first outlet was established at Lalupuram in Guntur.
accepted.tq: Use the location and sector together to identify the correct scheme.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The planned number of Mee Mart outlets in Andhra Pradesh is:
accepted.x: The programme plans to establish 1,000 Mee Mart outlets as part of PDS modernisation.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a planned network size from existing outlets or service counts.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Sanjeevani?
o: A PDS-modernisation programme first introduced at Lalupuram
A digital health-profile and ABHA-ID programme, statewide from 1 January 2027 after a Kuppam pilot
A free-bus-travel programme for women, statewide from 15 August 2025
A poverty-eradication programme launched on Ugadi 2025
accepted.x: Sanjeevani creates a digital health profile and ABHA ID; it was to become statewide from 1 January 2027 after the Kuppam pilot.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between schemes by pilot location, launch date and service objective.
accepted.sec: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following categories is included in the ₹4,000 monthly NTR Bharosa pension group?
o: Persons with more than 40% disability exclusively
Old-age persons, widows, weavers and toddy tappers
accepted.x: The ₹4,000 group includes old-age persons, widows, weavers, toddy tappers, fishermen, single women, transgender persons, artists and others.
accepted.tq: Identify the broad category group instead of selecting a specialised higher-rate category.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The monthly NTR Bharosa pension for persons with disabilities and persons affected by leprosy is:
accepted.x: The monthly pension for disabled persons and persons affected by leprosy is ₹6,000.
accepted.tq: Separate the standard pension rate from the specialised bedridden rate.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The monthly pension prescribed for fully bedridden persons suffering from bilateral elephantiasis or paralysis is:
accepted.x: Fully bedridden persons with bilateral elephantiasis or paralysis receive ₹15,000 per month, increased from ₹5,000.
accepted.tq: Use the specific medical-category description to identify the highest pension slab.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched under the NTR Bharosa pension categories?
o: Disabled persons with 40% or more disability — ₹6,000
Old-age persons aged 60 years and above — ₹4,000
accepted.x: Dialysis and CKDU patients receive ₹10,000 per month, not ₹15,000. The ₹15,000 rate applies to fully bedridden persons in the specified categories.
accepted.tq: Find the single reversed amount in a category–benefit table.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The ₹4,000 monthly pension for old-age persons, widows and other standard categories was raised from ₹3,000 in:
accepted.x: The standard NTR Bharosa pension was raised from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 in April 2024.
accepted.tq: Link the revised amount with the specific revision date rather than the later expenditure date.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NTR Bharosa pensions are generally delivered:
o: Through schools on the first working day of the year
At the doorstep on the first day of every month
Through banks only on the last day of every quarter
At ration shops on the fifteenth of each month
accepted.x: NTR Bharosa pensions are delivered at the doorstep on the first day of every month, observed as 'Pedala Sevalo' day.
accepted.tq: Apply the delivery model to a beneficiary-service situation.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is a new NTR Bharosa pension provision mentioned for 2026?
o: Pension only for government employees after retirement
Replacement of doorstep delivery by online-only payment
Abolition of pensions for dialysis patients
accepted.x: New provisions in 2026 included spouse pensions for surviving wives and pensions for dialysis and organ-transplant patients.
accepted.tq: Identify the newly added provision rather than the established delivery arrangement.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: On 1 September 2026, NTR Bharosa pensions involved which combination of outlay and beneficiaries?
accepted.x: The September 2026 disbursement was ₹2,693 crore for 61.92 lakh beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Match the date-specific expenditure figure with its corresponding beneficiary count.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement correctly reflects the comparison of disability pensions mentioned for Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh pays ₹6,000, compared with ₹10,000 in Bihar.
Andhra Pradesh pays ₹15,000, compared with ₹1,100 in Bihar.
Andhra Pradesh pays ₹1,100, compared with ₹15,000 in Bihar.
Both Andhra Pradesh and Bihar pay ₹15,000.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh pays ₹15,000 as the highest disability pension, while the comparable figure mentioned for Bihar is ₹1,100.
accepted.tq: Check the direction of the inter-State comparison and the two exact figures.
accepted.sec: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the hybrid NTR Vaidya Seva model announced in January 2025, trust-funded treatment for poor families is available up to:
accepted.x: The hybrid model provides insurance of ₹2.5 lakh per person for all residents and trust-funded treatment up to ₹25 lakh per family for poor families.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the per-person insurance ceiling from the poor-family trust-funded ceiling.
accepted.sec: Scheme limits - coverage ceiling, eligibility, model of delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding APSES 2024–25:
1. Procedures are covered up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
2. The total coverage can extend up to ₹25 lakh.
3. There is no limit for cancer treatment.
4. Annual family income eligibility is up to ₹5 lakh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: APSES 2024–25 provides the stated procedure ceiling, total ceiling, unlimited cancer coverage and income eligibility up to ₹5 lakh.
accepted.tq: Test all four dimensions of a scheme limit: procedure, total, exception and eligibility.
accepted.sec: Scheme limits - coverage ceiling, eligibility, model of delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The APSES 2024–25 coverage operates alongside which national health scheme providing ₹5 lakh per family?
accepted.x: APSES 2024–25 runs alongside Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, which provides coverage of ₹5 lakh per family.
accepted.tq: Distinguish similarly purpose-oriented welfare programmes by their sector and coverage unit.
accepted.sec: Scheme limits - coverage ceiling, eligibility, model of delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: APCNF stands for:
o: Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming
Andhra Pradesh Climate and Nature Forum
Andhra Pradesh Cooperative Natural Food programme
accepted.x: APCNF is the abbreviation for Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym exactly, paying attention to the words 'Community Managed Natural Farming'.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: APCNF is associated primarily with which sector and institution?
accepted.x: APCNF belongs to the agriculture sector and is associated with Rythu Sadhikara Samstha.
accepted.tq: Match the acronym’s full form with its sectoral institution.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Food Planet Prize recognition associated with APCNF?
o: It won a health-regulation award worth ₹15,000 crore in India.
It received the Food Planet Prize in 2024 for digital governance.
It won the 2026 Food Planet Prize worth $1.5 million in Sweden.
It was recognised by CDSCO as an anti-narcotics programme.
accepted.x: APCNF won the Food Planet Prize 2026, valued at $1.5 million, in Sweden in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine the award name, year, value and location to avoid famous-award traps.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In the context of Andhra Pradesh, SHRESTH refers to:
o: Social Health and Rehabilitation Scheme for Transgender Households
State Housing and Rural Employment Support Technology Hub
Statewide Hospital Response and Emergency Treatment Helpline
accepted.x: SHRESTH stands for State Health Regulatory Excellence Index and benchmarks State drug regulators.
accepted.tq: Reject plausible expansions by matching the acronym to the stated regulatory sector.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SHRESTH is run by which organisation under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare?
accepted.x: SHRESTH is run by CDSCO under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and benchmarks State drug regulators.
accepted.tq: Use the ‘who runs it?’ test to distinguish the regulator from implementing bodies of other schemes.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: EAGLE, in the context of Andhra Pradesh, is the abbreviation for:
o: Emergency Agricultural Growth and Livelihood Enterprise
Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement
Electronic Administration and Governance for Local Empowerment
Elite Action Group for Legal Education
accepted.x: EAGLE expands to Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement and functions as an AP Police anti-drug force.
accepted.tq: Expand a look-alike acronym by identifying its operational sector first.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: EAGLE is the AP Police anti-drug force. RTGS and AWARE relate to e-governance, while P4 concerns poverty eradication.
accepted.tq: Use sector-based elimination when several acronyms have similar administrative wording.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: RTGS and AWARE are associated with which sector?
accepted.x: RTGS means Real Time Governance Society and AWARE means AP Wide Area Real-time Execution; both are associated with e-governance.
accepted.tq: Identify the common sector before expanding the paired acronyms.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with its full form?
o: AWARE — Andhra Welfare and Agricultural Reform Establishment
P4 — Public Finance and Rural Rehabilitation
SHRESTH — State Rural Employment and Social Transformation Hub
accepted.x: RTGS stands for Real Time Governance Society. AWARE stands for AP Wide Area Real-time Execution, while P4 stands for Public-Private-People Partnership.
accepted.tq: Find the exact official expansion among near-sounding administrative alternatives.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms → full form + sector  [APPSC]
